summary: linux-clippy gets its own skip-policy entry (shadow, enforce false) keyed by exactly what the clippy stage reads, with the base's clippy-baseline as a base input the verifier computes; its gate job runs beside linux-gate's, and the clippy stage fails when cargo read a file the key does not cover (scripts/dep-info-check)

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes; CI's clippy stage note records one more input, clippy_base_baseline_sha256.

schema.detail: The skip policy accepts base_inputs on a kind: an input name mapped to a path whose sha256 at the accepted base a note must have recorded. A policy without it reads as before.

rules.detail: Shadow only: the linux-clippy gate never says skip while enforce is false. The clippy stage now also fails when its compiles read a repository file outside linux-clippy's inputs.

compatibility.detail: Existing notes and checks are unchanged; linux-gate still covers clippy as before.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; the shadow entry and gate job go with it.
